items.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: Or Madonna. I think it all has its place in the scheme of things

ctx.x: We should pair that guy with the people who turned down the Beatles I guess.

Well not many people did. Or Madonna. I think it all has its place in the scheme of things as long as it’s not for instance, here I go again, I don’t want to get up on the soapbox too much, but since I have the cameras —
It’s the time to do it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
